name: Yokozutsumi Yukie
source:
A daughter of Hokkaido's "Great Nature Ranch," she's a beautiful woman with a toned body and ample breasts.

She's a cheerful, friendly, and somewhat laid-back college student who helps out her parents while attending agricultural college. She doesn't overthink things and doesn't sweat the small stuff. Perhaps because she's not used to handling money, she has a somewhat poor sense of money, and Komachi often scolds her for it.

She also has a mischievous side and often unintentionally teases men, leading to misunderstandings, which has led to her being called a "natural bad girl," though she doesn't really understand this.

She is related to the Himejima family, a farming family in Akita, and has long been close with her cousin Komachi.

When Komachi was chosen as a "campaign girl," she came to her with concerns that she was "worried about going alone," so she decided to board the train with her to accompany her and promote her family's ranch, boarding first in Sapporo.

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20150110032328/http://www.turumiku.jp/matsuba/Yukie.html]official website, archived[/url]]
